critical_code_review_comments: AdminGoogleMap.jsx — useEffect heatmap rewrite is solid: try/catch around visualization.HeatmapLayer + fallback to weighted Circles. heatLayerRef and heatCirclesRef cleanup correctly via clear(). No crash, no overlay.
Console still emits the deprecated 'google.maps.Marker' warning. Non-blocking. Migrating to AdvancedMarkerElement is recommended but not urgent.
GooglePlacesInput.js still injects a raw <script> loader separate from useJsApiLoader (noted in iteration_128). Still recommended to consolidate, but does not impact this retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both runtime crashes are fixed and verified end-to-end. (1) SVG path 'Expected number at position 63, found M' — fixed by Material directions_car path (iteration_128). (2) Heat View 'Heatmap Layer no longer available' — fixed by try/catch + Circle fallback in AdminGoogleMap.jsx (iteration_129, this retest). Initial load, Heat View ON, Heat View OFF, and Mode Destination all confirmed with 0 page errors and 0 CRA overlay iframe.
rca of the issue: RESOLVED. Root cause: Google Maps JS API v3.65 (late 2025) removed visualization.HeatmapLayer; the constructor throws 'The Heatmap Layer functionality... is no longer available'. Fix in AdminGoogleMap.jsx: wraps HeatmapLayer instantiation in try/catch and falls back to weighted google.maps.Circle overlays (color-graded by intensity FACC15→F59E0B→EF4444, radius 250 + intensity*550m), with proper cleanup of both heatLayerRef and heatCirclesRef. The throw is now caught and downgraded to a console.warn, preventing window.onerror → CRA dev overlay propagation.
